# Pull request

## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Change type

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature or module behavior
- [ ] Balancing / values / ranges
- [ ] Localization
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Repository or GitHub metadata only
- [ ] Release packaging

## Affected area

- [ ] Core / `modDesc.xml`
- [ ] `lua/AdjustSuite.lua`
- [ ] `lua/AdjustSuite_Register.lua`
- [ ] Module files in `lua/`
- [ ] Localization in `l10n/`
- [ ] Assets in `dds/`
- [ ] README / documentation
- [ ] `.github/` templates or community files

## Repository structure checklist

- [ ] The repository root still matches the FS25 mod root.
- [ ] `modDesc.xml` remains in the repository root.
- [ ] Runtime mod files stay in `lua/`, `l10n/`, or `dds/`.
- [ ] GitHub-only files stay in `.github/` or root documentation files.
- [ ] No generated zip files, logs, savegames, cache files, or local test output were committed.

## Testing

- [ ] Tested in Farming Simulator 25.
- [ ] Checked `log.txt` for new errors or warnings.
- [ ] Tested on dedicated server, if affected.
- [ ] Localization was checked in-game, if text changed.
- [ ] Not applicable because this only changes documentation or GitHub metadata.

## Notes, screenshots, or logs

Add screenshots, videos, or relevant `log.txt` snippets if useful.
